headline: Akshay Poddar triggers SEBI Reg 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Zuari Agro Chemicals
sum: Akshay Poddar has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's takeover code, signalling a substantial share acquisition in Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure requirements and initiates the formal takeover regulatory process.
detail: Akshay Poddar has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE, as mandated by SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. This filing is triggered when an acquirer crosses specified thresholds of voting rights or shareholding in a listed company. The disclosure publicly notifies the market of the acquisition intent and activates the 90-calendar-day open-offer window during which the acquirer must make a public offering to remaining shareholders. No valuation or share count has been disclosed in the regulatory filing accessed.
